races.name: Dog Friendly Raceday Tues 2nd June Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Queens Wish
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally placed to track Cave Article with Charlie Todd's 5lb claim a significant advantage over this extended trip

runners_data.name: Cave Article
runners_data.note: Natural front runner whose poor recent trainer form is offset by his ability to control this race from the front if jumping holds up

runners_data.name: Delgany Deadline
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs Cave Article to serve up the race on a plate but has Harry Skelton's tactical nous in the saddle

runners_data.name: Warner's Cross
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but recent form figures include pulls-ups and falls, making him a risky proposition despite light weight

runners_data.name: Huckleberry Sting
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent Kempton win suggests return to form but needs strong pace to aim at from off the speed

runners_data.name: Crac De Megaudais
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 113-day break with inexperienced 5lb claimer Benjamin Macey taking over riding duties

runners_data.name: Tom Desjy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose tendency to fade in the finish makes him vulnerable over this stamina-sapping trip despite Sean Bowen riding

races.paceDynamic: Cave Article will lead from the start with no obvious pace pressure, allowing him to dictate terms at a sustainable gallop over this extended trip. Queens Wish and Tom Desjy are the only prominent runners likely to track the leader, but neither appears inclined to force a strong pace early. This sets up a tactical affair where the real racing begins from the home turn, with the hold-up horses relying on Cave Article maintaining his kick for home. This pace scenario clearly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems and capitalize on the steady early tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Cave Article Dictates Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Cave Article maintains his jumping rhythm and isn't pressured for the lead early
scenarios.body: The leader can string out the field at his own pace and prove difficult to peg back up the home straight when the hold-up horses make their moves. His class edge over this field becomes decisive when he's allowed to control the race from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Swamps Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Cave Article's jumping becomes sketchy or the pace collapses completely in the middle stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Delgany Deadline and Huckleberry Sting can unleash their finishing kicks with Harry Skelton and Jack Andrews timing their runs to perfection. Cave Article gets swamped by fresher finishers in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Queens Wish Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If Queens Wish can secure an ideal tracking position behind Cave Article without getting involved in early pace battles
scenarios.body: The prominent runner can use her tactical speed to challenge the leader approaching the last fence and prove strongest in the closing stages. Her recent good form and Charlie Todd's 5lb claim become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Cave Article makes jumping errors early or gets headed by Queens Wish before halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with no clear pace angle, leading to an attritional finish where stamina trumps class. The most battle-hardened performers grind out the finish in a tight bunch finish.

watchPoints.text: Cave Article's jumping under pressure - any early mistakes will hand the initiative to Queens Wish and compromise his front-running tactics
Tom Desjy's finishing effort - his recent form shows a pattern of fading late which could be exposed over this longer distance
Delgany Deadline's position turning for home - Harry Skelton needs to have him within striking distance to utilize his proven finishing kick
Queens Wish's early positioning - getting too close to Cave Article's pace could compromise her finishing effort up the home straight
The pace through the middle stages - if Cave Article strings them out too much, the hold-up horses will struggle to get competitive

races.name: Book The Bistro At Southwell Racecourse Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Seaview Rock
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with Sean Bowen aboard returns from a 79-day break but showed good form when winning at Hereford last time out.

runners_data.name: Dunkerque
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs a strong pace to be effective, with Jennie Candlish's yard in decent form recently and just 30 days since last run.

runners_data.name: Doc McCoy
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with mixed recent form including a pull-up, but Isabelle Ryder's 5lb claim is valuable and Jamie Snowden's yard is firing.

runners_data.name: Kara Sacre
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but returns from an 80-day absence for Venetia Williams, whose minimal recent runners make fitness a question mark.

runners_data.name: Rule Me In
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse receiving a massive 25lb weight allowance but Christian Williams' 0/11 recent record suggests stable form concerns despite the handicap opportunity.

races.paceDynamic: Seaview Rock will take the field along at a steady gallop with Doc McCoy and Kara Sacre tracking close behind in the prominent positions. The lack of confirmed early pace means Seaview Rock can dictate terms without serious pressure, creating a controlled tempo that builds gradually. Dunkerque and Rule Me In will be held up at the back, relying on their closing kicks over the final 3-4 furlongs. This race shape heavily favours the prominent racers who can stay close to the pace without having to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Seaview Rock sets uncontested fractions and the tempo stays manageable throughout
scenarios.body: The prominent trio get first run on the field and one of them kicks clear approaching the last fence. The hold-up horses have too much ground to make up in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the race becomes a sprint from 3 out
scenarios.body: Dunkerque's proven finishing kick becomes decisive as the field bunches up entering the home straight. Rule Me In also benefits from the strong pace but lacks the class to win.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Seaview Rock gets an easy lead and maintains momentum when challenged
scenarios.body: His prominent style allows him to dictate throughout and he finds enough in reserve when pressed in the final furlong. The others are picking up the pieces behind a game winner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and multiple horses make their move simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear tactical advantage, favouring the horse who jumps best under pressure. Experience and jumping accuracy become the deciding factors.

watchPoints.text: Rule Me In's 25lb weight advantage could be decisive if the pace sets up right, but Christian Williams' poor 14-day form is a major red flag.
Seavie Rock's 79-day absence needs monitoring for early sharpness, especially if asked to do the early pace-making work.
Doc McCoy showed concerning signs with that pull-up last time and needs to prove his jumping holds up under pressure.
Kara Sacre's headgear change to a hood suggests connections are trying something different after poor recent efforts.
Track the early pace carefully - if it's genuinely slow, Dunkerque becomes much more dangerous with his proven finishing kick.

races.paceDynamic: Pottersjetamay and Saachi will ensure a genuine gallop from the outset, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. Their honest pace will stretch the field and create opportunities for those tracking just behind, particularly the prominent racers who can sit handy without doing the donkey work. The strong gallop will expose any fitness concerns among the hold-up horses returning from lengthy absences. This shape favours prominent racers who can travel well in behind the leaders and kick when the pace-setters tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders set honest fractions without going suicidal
scenarios.body: Miss Kassiopi or Paragon can track the pace perfectly and pounce when Pottersjetamay and Saachi begin to tire in the final furlong. The tactical advantage of racing handy without leading suits this running style perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets first run on their rival
scenarios.body: Pottersjetamay's class edge and recent form could see him shake off Saachi early and maintain enough in reserve to hold the closers. His proven stamina at this trip gives him the ammunition to complete the job.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong between the two leaders
scenarios.body: Lheur De Gloire or Glenridding could benefit from a collapse up front, swooping late with their finishing kicks. The strong gallop would set up perfectly for horses with tactical speed held in reserve.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to fire or make jumping errors
scenarios.body: McGrath From Clune's recent good form or Sunset In Paris's return from a break could catch the field napping. Jumping errors or fitness concerns among the fancied runners would open the door.

watchPoints.text: Watch for early skirmishes between Pottersjetamay and Saachi potentially compromising both front-runners' chances
Monitor Lheur De Gloire and Glenridding for signs of ring-rustiness given their lengthy absences
Check Sunset In Paris for market support given his 554-day break suggests significant stable confidence if backed
Watch McGrath From Clune's jumping under pressure as inexperienced 7lb claimer takes the ride
Observe Miss Kassiopi's early positioning to see if she can secure the ideal tracking spot behind the leaders

runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 213-day break but holds class edge with OR 105 and strong Skelton yard form

runners_data.name: Willow Edge
runners_data.note: Lightly raced 7-year-old with concerning recent form, lacks the class depth for this contest

runners_data.name: King's Scholar
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up type with solid similar going record (4/15 1W1P) who should be prominent at the finish

runners_data.name: White Riot
runners_data.note: Lone pace-setter returning from 179-day layoff but proven at this trip with strong course record

runners_data.name: Provision
runners_data.note: Young hold-up horse with stamina proven but faces significant class rise after 135-day absence

runners_data.name: Sense Of Reason
runners_data.note: In-form hold-up runner with excellent recent RPR 116, well-suited to tactical scenario this sets up

runners_data.name: Fervent
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner making hurdling return after 291-day flat break, unknown quantity but intriguing potential

races.paceDynamic: White Riot stands alone as the confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the outset, with all other runners adopting hold-up or midfield tactics. With no pace pressure anticipated, White Riot can bowl along at a comfortable rhythm, setting sustainable fractions throughout the 2-mile journey. The lack of early pace will likely produce a tactical affair with runners bunched turning for home, before the race explodes in the final 3-4 furlongs. This moderate early pace followed by a sprint finish clearly favours the hold-up horses who can deliver their challenge late when it matters most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If White Riot sets uncontested fractions and the field remains bunched turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 3 out with hold-up horses getting first run on a tiring leader. Class and finishing speed become decisive with the patient tactics rewarded.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If White Riot gets easy early sectionals and maintains strong galloping rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The leader's 6-year-old stamina and lack of early pressure allows sustained kick from 2 out. Hold-up horses struggle to peg back the advantage despite late rally.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If White Riot goes too slow early and creates stop-start tempo with false pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy crawling affair with positioning crucial at the business end. Horses with tactical speed and nimble jumping benefit from chaotic rhythm.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Sense Of Reason or King's Scholar track closer than expected and apply early pressure
scenarios.body: White Riot gets hustled along at quicker tempo, creating genuine test of stamina. Strong stayers with proven form lines gain advantage in testing conditions.

watchPoints.text: White Riot's jumping under pressure - any early mistakes could compromise the lone pace-setter's rhythm and open tactical opportunities
Louis Veron's fitness levels after 213-day break, particularly how sharply he travels in behind turning for home
Sense Of Reason and King's Scholar positioning through halfway - if either tracks closer than usual it signals pace injection
Fervent's jumping technique on hurdling return after extended flat campaign, any rustiness could prove costly
How quickly the field closes on White Riot from 3 out - rapid closure suggests the pace was insufficient

runners_data.name: Ballygeary
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits the likely pace but 45 days off and poor recent form are concerns despite the tongue-tie being applied.

runners_data.name: Shengai Enki

runners_data.name: Duffry Trixs
runners_data.note: Hold-up style fits perfectly but needs to overcome 33 days off and the burden of top weight against this field.

runners_data.name: Heard That
runners_data.note: Sean Bowen's booking is significant for a hold-up horse that should get the perfect setup in this race shape.

runners_data.name: Havefunontherun
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but the 142-day absence is a major concern despite the tongue-tie and yard's decent recent form.

runners_data.name: Copper Beach
runners_data.note: Prominent style gives him an edge over the hold-up majority, though 510 days off is extreme even with the weight advantage.

runners_data.name: Sutherland
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form who should benefit from the anticipated pace scenario and quality jockey booking.

runners_data.name: Prairie Diamond
runners_data.note: The key pace angle with visor applied, likely to get an easy lead but must prove he can last home when challenged.

runners_data.name: Madajovy
runners_data.note: Hold-up style fits the race shape perfectly but 55 days off and inconsistent recent efforts are question marks.

runners_data.name: Eternity Rose
runners_data.note: Young hold-up horse with decent recent form who could benefit if the race becomes a messy sprint finish.

runners_data.name: Ballela Blaze
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying bottom weight but the 391-day layoff makes him hard to trust despite good historical form.

races.paceDynamic: Prairie Diamond will be the sole genuine pace-setter, likely taking this field along at a measured gallop with Shengai Enki, Copper Beach and Ballela Blaze settling in behind but not applying early pressure. The lack of natural pace angles means Prairie Diamond can dictate terms without being harassed, creating a race where the tempo may not truly ignite until approaching the home turn. With 8 of 11 runners showing hold-up tendencies, this sets up perfectly for horses that can quicken from off the pace, as the final half-mile will see a wall of runners trying to make ground simultaneously. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with a sharp turn of foot who can capitalize on the inevitable bunching and sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Prairie Diamond gets an easy lead and the pace stays modest throughout.
scenarios.body: Prairie Diamond will have too much in reserve when the hold-up horses try to rally, staying on strongly up the hill. The lack of early pace pressure means the leaders get first run on ground that may cut up later in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses get clear runs and the pace quickens approaching the home turn.
scenarios.body: The race will develop into a cavalry charge with Heard That, Sutherland and Duffry Trixs all unleashing finishing kicks simultaneously. Sean Bowen's tactical nous on Heard That could prove decisive in timing the challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Shengai Enki or Copper Beach track the pace closely and kick on before the hold-up horses get organized.
scenarios.body: The prominent runners will get first run on the field while the hold-up brigade are still making ground from the back. Copper Beach's long absence could be offset by his low weight and good trainer form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the large field of hold-up horses causes significant interference in the straight.
scenarios.body: Eternity Rose or Havefunontherun could benefit from a cleaner passage while others are held up or forced wide. The race becomes a lottery based more on luck than merit.

watchPoints.text: Prairie Diamond's jumping under pressure - if he makes an error when the field closes he could bring down others in the pack.
Watch for traffic problems in the straight as 8 hold-up horses try to make ground simultaneously through a potentially narrow gap.
Copper Beach's fitness after 510 days off - any signs of greenness or blowing could end his chances quickly.
Sean Bowen's positioning on Heard That - his tactical awareness could be crucial in timing the challenge from the back.
The pace through the first mile - if Prairie Diamond goes too slowly early the sprint finish becomes even more frantic.
